```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(leaflet)
library(jsonlite)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
raw <- read_json("data/wildfires.geojson", simplifyVector = FALSE)

wildfires <- tibble(features = raw$features) |>
  unnest_wider(features) |>
  unnest_wider(properties)

fires <- wildfires |>
  unnest_wider(geometry, names_sep = "_") |>
  select(incident, gis_acres, fire_year, agency, state, geometry_coordinates) |>
  mutate(
    gis_acres = as.numeric(gis_acres),
    fire_year = as.integer(fire_year)
  )
```

```{r}
august_fires <- fires |>
  filter(str_detect(incident, regex("\\bAugust\\b", ignore_case = TRUE)))

nrow(august_fires)

fires |>
  slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE)
```

```{r}
big_fires <- fires |>
  filter(gis_acres >= 100000) |>
  mutate(
    lon = map_dbl(
      geometry_coordinates,
      \(rings) mean(map_dbl(purrr::flatten(rings), \(point) point[[1]]))
    ),
    lat = map_dbl(
      geometry_coordinates,
      \(rings) mean(map_dbl(purrr::flatten(rings), \(point) point[[2]]))
    )
  )
```

```{r}
leaflet(big_fires) |>
  addTiles() |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~lon,
    lat = ~lat,
    radius = ~sqrt(gis_acres) / 100
  ) |>
  setView(lng = -115, lat = 40, zoom = 4)
```
